expectations.text: Review names Cynefin domain as Clear
expectations.evidence: Cynefin domain: Clear — gem version bump with known cause-effect

expectations.text: Review selects Quick tier (sub-hour appetite, fully reversible)
expectations.evidence: Tier: Quick — selected because none of the Full auto-select attributes hold

expectations.text: Review does not invent concerns to look thorough — most buckets OVERTURNED OR a SUSTAINED finding (e.g., on `bundle update` scope) is downgraded to a recommendation under the Quick-tier reversibility carve-out
expectations.evidence: Three buckets (B1, B2, B3) SUSTAINED. B2/B3 downgraded under carve-out as expected, BUT B1 (no problem statement) is SUSTAINED and NOT covered by carve-out — blocks APPROVE. The skill's carve-out as written doesn't cover B1; the agent surfaced this gap in its review.

expectations.text: B8 (pre-mortem) names rubocop rule changes / CI breakage as a low-likelihood failure mode with revert as kill-switch
expectations.evidence: B8 names new default-enabled cops as top failure mode; kill-switch is `bundle exec rubocop` precheck (variant of revert — both bound the blast radius)

expectations.text: Final recommendation is APPROVE (may include a named recommendation like `bundle update --conservative rubocop` — but verdict is APPROVE, not REVISE)
expectations.evidence: Recommendation: REVISE — the plan has SUSTAINED B1. Verdict is REVISE, not APPROVE.

expectations.text: Review length is proportionate — does not bloat into Full-tier output for a 30-min reversible change
expectations.evidence: Review runs ~76 lines with full B-bucket tables and 6 conditions — heavier than a Quick-tier review should be for a 30-min change
